label: U.S. AGENCY FOR INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENT
opm_label_note: OPM displayed "U.S. INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENT COOPERATION AGENCY" for this period. That agency was abolished effective 1999-04-01 (Public Law 105-277, division G, sections 1401 and 1411; 64 FR 15717), and from then the only unit reporting under AM was USAID. The relabel starts at OPM's next row boundary, 1999-10-01; OPM itself changed the label to USAID on 2011-04-01.
source: Public Law 105-277, division G, sections 1401 and 1411; 64 FR 15717; OPM agency and subelement table

label: CONSUMER FINANCIAL PROTECTION BUREAU
opm_label_note: OPM displays "FEDERAL RESERVE SYSTEM". The Board of Governors (FRBG) does not submit personnel data to OPM; the only unit reporting under FR is the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (FRFT), established by Public Law 111-203, title X.
source: Public Law 111-203, title X; OPM agency and subelement table (FRBG, FRFT)

label: INTERNATIONAL BOUNDARY AND WATER COMMISSION, U.S. SECTION
opm_label_note: OPM displayed "INTERNATIONAL BOUNDARY AND WATER COMMISSION: UNITED STATES AND MEXICO". The reporting unit is the United States Section; the Mexican Section reports to the Government of Mexico. OPM adopted the U.S. Section name on 2018-01-01.
source: OPM agency and subelement table (row of 2018-01-01); U.S. Government Manual

label: COMMITTEE FOR PURCHASE FROM PEOPLE WHO ARE BLIND OR SEVERELY DISABLED
opm_label_note: OPM displays "... PEOPLE WHO ARE BLIND AND SEVERELY DISABLED" from 2016-08-01. The name in statute (41 U.S.C. 8502) and in the Committee's own Federal Register notices is "... BLIND OR SEVERELY DISABLED".
source: 41 U.S.C. 8502; Federal Register, Committee notices of 2016-07-15 and 2016-09-16

label: U.S. TAX COURT
opm_label_note: OPM displays "JUDICIAL BRANCH". From 2013-08-01 the only JL subelement that submits personnel data is JL03, the U.S. Tax Court; the Supreme Court (JL01) and U.S. Courts (JL02) do not. The Tax Court is a court established under Article I (26 U.S.C. 7441), not part of the Judicial Branch.
source: 26 U.S.C. 7441; OPM agency and subelement table (JL01, JL02, JL03)

label: OFFICE OF ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES
opm_label_note: OPM displays "OFFICE OF THE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGE" from 1996-01-01, a form found in no source. The U.S. Government Manual and the Department of Agriculture's Federal Register documents use "Office of Administrative Law Judges" throughout.
source: U.S. Government Manual, 1973-1993 editions; 60 FR 56392; Federal Register, Department of Agriculture documents 1995-1997

label: ORGANIZATION OF THE JOINT CHIEFS OF STAFF
opm_label_note: OPM displays the placeholder "TRANSLATION UNKNOWN" for this one month, between "ORGANIZATION OF THE JOINT CHIEFS OF STAFF" (through 1988-11-30) and "JOINT STAFF" (from 1989-01-01). The same unit reports throughout: 288, 306 and 292 employees in the 1988-09, 1988-12 and 1989-03 snapshots. FWOC shows the earlier name, so the change of name stays on the date OPM gives it.
source: OPM agency and subelement table; FWOC employment records for DD02

label: JOINT STAFF
opm_label_note: OPM displays "ORGANIZATION OF THE JOINT CHIEFS OF STAFF" from 1994-02-01, a name the Goldwater-Nichols Act of 1986 (Public Law 99-433) retired. The statute and the U.S. Government Manual name the unit the Joint Staff, which OPM itself displayed from 1989-01-01 to 1994-01-31.
source: Public Law 99-433; U.S. Government Manual, 1992-1996 editions

label: DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE EDUCATION ACTIVITY
opm_label_note: OPM displays "DEPARTMENT OF WAR EDUCATION ACTIVITY" from 2026-05-01. Executive Order 14347 (90 FR 43893) makes "Department of War" a secondary title; the name in statute is unchanged.

label: FEDERAL PRISON INDUSTRIES, INC

source: Act of June 23, 1934, Public Law 73-461, 48 Stat. 1211; Executive Order 6917 of December 11, 1934; U.S. Government Manual, 1972-1987 editions
